knowledge_gaps: Training-prefix targets were already available during fitting. Their perturbation results measure in-sample sensitivity, not generalization or current user intent.

The protocol leaves prefix selection, truncation, deletion counts, temporal windows, shuffle size, candidate sampling, repeated-target handling, and rank ties unspecified. Perturbations must operate on the same visible truncated history to avoid introducing previously unseen older items.

Final-position extraction alone does not guarantee padding invariance: GRU biases can change hidden states while processing zero embeddings. The implementation must verify padding-state handling and preserve the documented B × L scoring interface.
The adapter receives one category model at a time, but cross-category aggregation and bootstrap ownership are unspecified. Sample limits, runtime limits, and resource accounting are also missing.

Originality 4/10 is reasonable, but potential 8/10 is speculative without measurements. Difficulty 3/10 understates interface verification and reproducibility work. A last-item-only input ablation of the same trained model would provide a useful additional control without introducing another predictor.

follow_up_queries.reason: Clarify recurrent padding behavior and scoring compatibility before interpreting temporal effects.
follow_up_queries.query: For PyTorch GRU4Rec with left-padded histories and per-position B × L × H features, how should padding steps be skipped or masked so added leading zeros cannot alter valid hidden states? Compare packed sequences with explicit masked recurrent updates, and describe invariance checks and B × L × K candidate scoring that preserve a per-position ModelView interface.

follow_up_queries.reason: Make the perturbation experiment reproducible and distinguish memory utility from truncation artifacts, memorization, and synthetic distribution shifts.
follow_up_queries.query: What controls are recommended for deletion and order-perturbation diagnostics in sequential recommendation when next-item targets come from histories already used for training? Address perturbing only the original truncated window, retaining the final item, matched deletion counts, last-item-only input ablation of the same model, fixed unique candidates, repeated targets, deterministic rank ties, and limits on generalization claims.

follow_up_queries.reason: Specify statistically interpretable aggregation within the shared compute budget and calibrate the proposal's expected value.
follow_up_queries.query: How should paired sequential-recommendation diagnostic effects be aggregated across four separately trained category models using one training prefix per sampled user? Describe stratified user bootstrap intervals for an equal-weight category macro mean, minimum slice counts, missing categories, bounded GPU diagnostic sampling, and limitations of confidence intervals after repeated validation-guided model search.
